about: Lint runner and rule mutants (wf10 LINT0). Each is killed by the package's seeded properties: TestSuppressionAgreesWithModel (runner, configuration, directive grammar) and the per-rule reference properties.

mutants.name: lint0-unchecked-runs-rules
mutants.rule: On unchecked source no rule runs and every known directive is not-evaluated: unchecked-source.

mutants.name: lint0-covers-own-line
mutants.rule: A directive covers the next line, not its own.

mutants.name: lint0-unused-not-reported
mutants.rule: An unused suppression of a completed rule is an L001 error.

mutants.name: lint0-reserved-namespace-admitted
mutants.rule: A directive in a reserved namespace (ergo/, builtin/) is unknown: L001.

mutants.name: lint0-off-rule-unused
mutants.rule: A directive of an off rule is not-evaluated: rule-off, never unused.

mutants.name: lint0-failed-rule-unused
mutants.rule: A directive of a failed rule is not-evaluated: facts-unavailable; a rule that did not complete proves nothing unused.

mutants.name: lint0-failure-complete
mutants.rule: A failed rule makes the run incomplete, which fails policy.

mutants.name: lint0-panic-passes
mutants.rule: A rule that panics fails with L000; it never completes clean.

mutants.name: lint0-bad-span-passes
mutants.rule: A rule that reports outside its file fails with L000.

mutants.name: lint0-suppression-keeps-finding
mutants.rule: An applied directive removes the findings it covers.

mutants.name: lint0-severity-dropped
mutants.from: f.Code, f.Rule, f.Severity = rule.Code, rule.Name, severity
mutants.to: f.Code, f.Rule, f.Severity = rule.Code, rule.Name, rule.Default
mutants.rule: A finding carries the configured severity, not the rule's default.

mutants.name: lint0-options-only-stays-off
mutants.rule: A setting with no severity turns an off rule on at its default.

mutants.name: lint0-presets-ignored
mutants.rule: The command line's presets are layers after extends and before the document's rules.

mutants.name: lint0-reason-optional
mutants.rule: A directive without a reason is malformed (L001).

mutants.name: lint0-two-rules-admitted
mutants.rule: A directive names one rule.

mutants.name: lint0-glued-word-directive
mutants.rule: A comment whose first word only starts with the directive word is no directive.

mutants.name: lint0-silent-return-ignored
mutants.rule: An arm that returns leaves a trace.

mutants.name: lint0-silent-try-ignored
mutants.rule: An arm that fails on through try leaves a trace.

mutants.name: lint0-silent-footprint-ignored
mutants.rule: An arm that calls anything with an effect leaves a trace.

mutants.name: lint0-silent-reads-ignored
mutants.rule: An arm that reads its failure binding is not silent.

mutants.name: lint0-silent-enters-literals
mutants.rule: A return inside a function literal is that literal's frame, not the arm's.

mutants.name: lint0-fep-unexported
mutants.rule: Only an exported function is a public boundary.

mutants.name: lint0-fep-any-error
mutants.rule: The rule matches go.Error by identity, not the program's own error types.
